tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang zlog zhal shes snyan brgyud dang rgyun byang yod/ 1$00003001gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba na// dgra bgegs chu glang pad nyi'i gdan steng du// rang nyid skad cig 'jam dpal tshe bdag ni// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan gsum bsgrad// dbu skra sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor// phyag g.yon lcags kyus bkug ste sgrol bar mdzad// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs khro chas rdzogs// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal bar gyur// sku las 'phros pa'i me dpung mtshon cha dang*// 'khor los dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong rnams// rang gshed rang 'beb rjes med brlags par gyur/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: he ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras srungs: sarba tsit+ta gzir thums bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya: saṃ gh+ri bā ri nṛ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ dza: bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa swā hā:1$0000270 zhes srung sngags dang*/ gong gi /rbad ya zlog ya: zhes pa'i mjug tu/ 1$0000300dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i sha la rgyug: snying la mā ra ya rgyug: dbugs la rgyug: srog la mā ra ya rgyug: khrag la rgyug: rtsa la mā ra ya rgyug: hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya zlog ya:1$0000270 zhes btags pa zlog sngags ci mang brjod/ mthar thal mo brdabs nas dmigs med du 'jog go /1$0000300oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ṇi bh+yo: mā ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+shan: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya: ya ma rā dza: kī la ya bh+yo:1$0000270 zhes pa ni sngags kyi zhal shes yang dag pa'o/1$0000300 2ྈྈྈྈ sogs dus gnyan gyi tshe/ shā sha 'di nyid/ ྈྈྈྈྈ la ka na kas bris pa'i gzugs brnyan/

ྈྈྈ la shar ba pha na gi sa dza t+r+zha sha na sa ྈྈ de/ bzhes pa dang*/ 3ha cang byad ltas 'tshub cing sngags bzlas kyang zhi bar ma gyur pa'i tshe/ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ drag shing la bcos te/ ྈ so sor yig 'bru tsheg med pa re re nas bris te lhung bzed kyi nang du blug /dar nag gis kha bcad/ g.yon skor du bsrub cing sngags bgrang*/ de yang sde brgyad thebs pa'i dus gnyan gyi nyi ma nub pa dang sprad mthar dmod mo dang thal rdeb bya/ 4yang sha dmar dum bu chung ngu btsan dug cung zad kyis bsgos pa phyag mthil du bzhag ste dgug gzhug mang du mdzad/ dgra bo dngos su gyur pa de rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal bas bzhes/ lto bar las gshin rus sbal rngams pa mi zan gyi khar chud pas thal ba rdul phran ltar brlags par mos/ de nas zlog sngags bgrang ba'i mchil ma rnams kyang dgra bor gsal bas mid de lto ba'i rus sbal gyi khar 'phangs pas ches rno zhing las myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba lags/ de dag yang zlog skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i yi ger med nges pa'i snyan brgyud 'ga' zhig phul ba lags pas thugs kyi dpal be'ur sbas pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dza yan+tu/1$0000250 ༄༅// yang zlog rdo rje pha lam khyer bde shin tu zab pa zhig bzhugs so// 1$0000300stong pa'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su// chu glang zung bzhi bdud bzhi nyi zla'i steng*// hūm̐ las bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// tshe bdag nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// shin tu khro gtum mi bzad tsham rngam 'bar// phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong bskor// gnod byed byad ma'i klad khrag zho ltar dkrug /g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams pa yis// dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying 'dren yan lag 'ching*// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum byad ma 'dam ltar brdzis// zhal nas drag po'i sngags sgra sgrog pa yis// byad ma lha srung snying srog 'dral bar byed// bskal pa'i me dpung rdo rje'i 'khor lo yi// gur khang dbus su rab 'jigs nga rgyal bskyed// oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo:
ma ni mā ra ṇi bh+yo: mā ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+shan: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: mā ra ya: ya ma rā dza: kī la ya bh+yo:

zhes mchil ma dor ba gang nus bzla/ mthar ni bden stobs brjod pa'i thal mo brdab ste/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma mgon 'khor bcas dang*// gsang rig gzungs sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin/ khyad par tshe bdag nag po'i bden mthu yis// bdag la gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po dang*// byad ma lha srung kho rang byas pa yi// nus pa phyir zlogs byad ma rang gshed phob// mtshon dug sbyor ngan rbod gtong rdul du rlogs// hūm̐ shā ri bh+yo zlog: e sa bh+yo zlog: ki sa bh+yo zlog: man+t+ra bir+wa bh+yo zlog: mthar ni dmigs med spros bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs dka'i srung 'khor bsgom// des ni phur thogs 'bum yang nus pa rdugs// zhes pa 'di mi phyed dad gus mchog ldan sde pa yangs grong pa dngos grub phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 'byung po'i nyi ma la sbyar ba'o/// /
